dialogues.speaker: Sisi
dialogues.text: My lover, Chaoxi. He's a sailor.

dialogues.speaker: Sisi
dialogues.text: We don't get to see each other very often, he's never back on land for very long...

dialogues.speaker: Sisi
dialogues.text: He's already been gone for so long, who knows when he'll be back...

dialogues.speaker: Sisi
dialogues.text: Next time he gets back I'm just going to ask him outright when we are going to get married. All this waiting is just too much...
